§6Magnetized Tungsten

§aTungsten infused with schrabidium. The gate to CMB Steel.

§bMagnetized Tungsten§f is tungsten alloyed with trace schrabidium-326. The schrabidium boosts durability, conductivity, heat resistance, and magnetism. Lighter than normal tungsten with distinctive stripes.

§6Production§f:
• §bBlast Furnace§f: 1 Tungsten Ingot + 1 Schrabidium Nugget → 1 Magnetized Tungsten Ingot
• §bCrucible§f: 8 Tungsten Nuggets + 1 Schrabidium Nugget → 1 Ingot (more efficient)

§6Key Uses§f:
• §bCMB Steel§f: 6 Magnetized Tungsten Nuggets + 3 Poisonous Mud Nuggets in crucible
• §bSuperconductors§f rated to 4,000K, late-game equivalent of advanced alloy
• Energy Powder: Glowstone + Diamond Powder + Magnetized Tungsten Powder
• Contained Counter-Resonant Singularity for DFC

§ePS:§f No schrabidium, no magnetized tungsten, no CMB Steel. Get your schrabidium chain running first.
